preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, K must be between 1 and N, and N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**6 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element of the array A must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(A[i] == A[N - 1 - i] for i in range(N // 2)) or (K == 1 and all(A[i] == A[N - 1 - i] for i in range(N // 2)))
postconditions.description: If K is 1, the array must already be palindromic; otherwise, it must be possible to make it palindromic.
